title: docker-compose: drive all settings from .env so LIVE mode needs no file edits
body:
## Summary
Previously the `environment:` block in `docker-compose.yml` **hard-coded** `SIMULATION_MODE: "true"`, and `environment:` takes precedence over `env_file:`, so a `.env` with `SIMULATION_MODE=false` was silently ignored — going LIVE required editing the compose file. This switches every value to `${VAR:-default}` interpolation (Compose substitutes from `.env`/shell), so:

- Zero-config `docker compose up` still boots in **simulation** (defaults preserved).
- Setting `SIMULATION_MODE=false` + `DEVIN_*`/`GITHUB_*` in `.env` now runs **LIVE** with no edits to the compose file.

```diff
-      SIMULATION_MODE: "true"
+      SIMULATION_MODE: "${SIMULATION_MODE:-true}"
+      DEVIN_API_KEY: "${DEVIN_API_KEY:-}"
+      DEVIN_ORG_ID: "${DEVIN_ORG_ID:-}"
+      GITHUB_REPO: "${GITHUB_REPO:-royendo/superset-devin}"
+      GITHUB_TOKEN: "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}"
+      ... (POLL/ISSUE_POLL/SIM_* and TRIGGER_LABELS likewise)
```
`DATABASE_PATH` stays pinned to `/app/data` (the mounted volume path). README "Going LIVE" updated to note LIVE works straight from `.env`, and that the `s` keyboard shortcut needs an attached terminal (use `make run` or `POST /poll/run` instead of `docker compose up`).

## Verification
- `docker compose config` with no `.env` → `SIMULATION_MODE: "true"`; with `.env` `SIMULATION_MODE=false` → resolves to `false` (and `ISSUE_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS` override respected).
- `docker compose up --build` boots the container: `/health` reports `simulation_mode=true, monitored_repo=royendo/superset-devin`; startup scan auto-created 5 simulated sessions.
- `pytest` (9), `ruff`, `mypy` green.

## Test plan
```bash
cp .env.example .env   # set SIMULATION_MODE=false + DEVIN_*/GITHUB_* for LIVE
docker compose up --build
curl -X POST localhost:8000/poll/run
open http://localhost:8000/dashboard
```
